Those “same link” rules feel right, provided only known tracking details are ignored. Other query details may genuinely change the page, so those should remain part of the link. Ignoring the protocol, `www`, host capitalization, trailing slash, fragment, and common tracking parameters is fine.

The archived case is also handled well: tell me where the bookmark is and offer to restore it rather than restoring automatically.

One correction: finding and highlighting the existing bookmark isn’t quite enough. A duplicate save should take me directly to editing that existing bookmark—or give me a clear “Edit existing” action—so I can update its title, description, link, tags, note, or reading status instead of creating another copy. The same edit option should be available when the existing copy is archived.
